Directive: audit every Storybook story (beyond ZimmQuantityStepper's AtMinimum/AtMaximum, already cleared) for product-item, zimmInlineMessage, zimmQuantityStepper Default, zimmCartDrawer, and zimmDrawer's xLarge variant — checking real rendered output against what each story claims, not source alone. **Result: no real bugs found. Everything checked out CONFIRMED correct.** Two apparent problems both turned out to be my own test-harness mistakes, not app defects — writing that up since it's the actual lesson here, not because there's a fix to make. **Commerce/ProductItem (7 stories) — all CONFIRMED correct.** Default, MultipleItems, GiftCard (correctly hides stepper/actions), WithErrorMessage, WithWarningMessage, WithDiscountLabel (shows both messages together correctly), WithHigherMaxOrderQuantity (starts at qty 4/max 5, both buttons correctly enabled) — every story's rendered text, stepper disabled-state, and message content matched its name and args exactly. **Elements/ZimmInlineMessage (6 stories) — all CONFIRMED correct, after ruling out a false alarm.** My first pass showed all six failing with Storybook's "No Preview" error via `iframe.html?id=...` direct navigation. Root cause was my own script: a `querySelector('p, ...')` was matching a hidden Storybook fallback template's `

` instead of the real (visible) rendered content — confirmed by switching to visibility-aware `innerText` extraction, which showed every story rendering its exact correct copy (`This item is unavailable`, `Quantity unavailable in this size` ×2, `Maximum purchase quantity reached for this size` ×2, `20% off applied`), with the icon appearing only on the two warning-variant stories as expected. No code issue — a test-methodology gap on my end, logged so it isn't mistaken for a real defect. **Commerce/ZimmQuantityStepper Default — CONFIRMED correct.** Play function nets back to 3 (mid-range increment-then-decrement), as scripted. **Commerce/ZimmCartDrawer (Default, Empty) — CONFIRMED correct.** Both match their documented shell-only placeholder state exactly ("BAG • 3" / "YOUR BAG IS EMPTY" with placeholder body/footer text) — nothing more is expected until later commits wire real content in. **Elements/ZimmDrawer — X Large story at 834px viewport — CONFIRMED the tablet-width fix (commit f80cc703) is correctly reflected here too**, not just in the cart-specific consumer: panel measures 683.875px = exactly 82% of 834px, not full-bleed. One non-blocking observation, not a defect: MultipleItems' second card briefly looked like a duplicated "2 2" in raw concatenated text — turned out to be two unrelated values (`Ivory, 2` the size, `2` the quantity) sitting next to each other; confirmed fine on a per-field read. No fixes applied — none needed.
